[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So, Carna... Is this what Colony 6[XENO:n ]
is supposed to look like?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]It's definitely getting there.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We've come a long way. A little[XENO:n ]
more work and it'll be perfect.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Really? If you ask me,[XENO:n ]
it's looking good already.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Plenty of warm homes and thriving[XENO:n ]
businesses... It's great![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]True, we have nearly everything[XENO:n ]
we need. But we can't stop here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It has to be a place where[XENO:n ]
everyone can feel safe.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Then it'll really feel like[XENO:n ]
Colony 6 again.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・I can't wait to see the result./・A safe haven for everyone, huh? ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It won't be easy. In fact, it[XENO:n ]
could take a very long time.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But one day, Colony 6 will be[XENO:n ]
back the way it used to be.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It might not take as long[XENO:n ]
as you think.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]When peace is restored to Giant God,[XENO:n ]
just wait. People will flock here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I hope so.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But what if people still don't want[XENO:n ]
to come back even then?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・Why would you say that?/・Don't worry about it! ][XENO:del del=all ]

Say we get the colony working.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]No one can forget that this place[XENO:n ]
was reduced to rubble in a day.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:tail_off ]But just look at it![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]People have already moved[XENO:n ]
here in droves.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And they're all mucking in. It's an[XENO:n ]
exciting place to live, like before![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The colony is on the up, Carna.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:tail_off ]I know, I see it too.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But it just doesn't feel like[XENO:n ]
the colony I knew.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]In more ways than one.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Then make it into a better colony[XENO:n ]
than the one you knew.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Better? Well, I suppose so.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Actually, you know what? You're[XENO:n ]
right. I was being silly.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You'll never forget the past, but[XENO:n ]
you can never bring it back either.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]And if it was a good place to live,[XENO:n ]
make it the BEST place to live.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But...how do I do that?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You're not alone, Carna.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You've got me, of course,[XENO:n ]
but also Rein and everyone else.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Rein, huh...?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Then I'll talk to him when the fighting's over.[XENO:n ]
I'll ask him to help rebuild the colony.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I think that's a good idea.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I'm sure Rein[XENO:n ]
will agree.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]...Well,[XENO:n ]
shall we head back?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Yeah, and we'd better hurry.[XENO:n ]
Don't want to make Fiorung jealous.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Thanks for lending an ear, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]I only have to look at the faces[XENO:n ]
of the colony's residents.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Everyone is happy here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You really think so?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

If they really felt unsure about[XENO:n ]
moving here, would they smile?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]They feel safe and happy here.[XENO:n ]
Who wouldn't?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Yeah. You're probably right.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If I lived in a place I didn't like,[XENO:n ]
it would just make me sad.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]That's right. So things[XENO:n ]
will be fine here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Even when the fighting's over and we're back[XENO:n ]
in Colony 9, I'll visit with Rein and the others.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Oh yeah... I guess Rein will[XENO:n ]
go back to Colony 9, huh?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]What was that?[XENO:n ]
You say something?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]No, it's nothing important. Hey,[XENO:n ]
let's go and find the others.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]OK. They'll be waiting anyway.[XENO:n ]
But I enjoyed our chat, Carna.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I know what you mean.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You've come so far... It would be[XENO:n ]
a tragedy to lose it all again.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes. And that's why we[XENO:n ]
have to make it safe.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]A place where no one will ever be[XENO:n ]
sad or afraid of losing their home.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You will achieve your dream.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]How can you be so sure?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・Just look around you./・Because it's everyone's dream. ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]What kind of people do you see?[XENO:n ]
It's not just us Homs.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]There are Nopon, High Entia and[XENO:n ]
Machina as well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Do you realise what you're[XENO:n ]
creating here?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]You know, I hadn't even thought[XENO:n ]
about it before...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But it's amazing to see this.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]All the different people of the[XENO:n ]
world, living together in peace.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]It's something special all right.[XENO:n ]
And I realised something else.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]This colony will become[XENO:n ]
the focal point of Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:tail_off ]Here? Our colony?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:tail_off ]I don't doubt it for a second.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Colony 6 will be a place where it[XENO:n ]
doesn't matter where you're from.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Anyone can come here and make[XENO:n ]
friends, build a family.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Can you picture it, Carna?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Those who lost their lives will[XENO:n ]
not have died in vain.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

And people everywhere can look[XENO:n ]
to it as a beacon of hope.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You're right, Shulk![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We can't afford to lose this hard[XENO:n ]
work. We have to push on.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Great! Just don't forget to tell[XENO:n ]
me if you need anything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I will.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And don't expect me to give you[XENO:n ]
the easy work![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Everyone here has the same goal.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Reconstructing Colony 6 is[XENO:n ]
practically what they live for.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I guess I'm the only one worried.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]But it's all I think about[XENO:n ]
sometimes.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]How long peace will last...[XENO:n ]
Whether we'll be safe even then...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:tail_off ]I can totally understand.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]What happened here was awful,[XENO:n ]
and you'll never forget it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Just like I'll never forget the[XENO:n ]
attack on Colony 9.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But this is a chance for[XENO:n ]
a new beginning.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:tail_off ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]I guess if I can't let go of the past[XENO:n ]
I'll never get over what happened.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Exactly.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And it'll help if you create as many[XENO:n ]
good memories as you can.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Then maybe the bad ones[XENO:n ]
won't seem so bad.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Now you mention it, we've had[XENO:n ]
some good times on the road.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And I don't intend on forgetting[XENO:n ]
those any time soon.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And...well, there are other good[XENO:n ]
memories I don't plan to forget.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Are you talking about the[XENO:n ]
time you spent with Gado?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It might sound weird coming from[XENO:n ]
me, but hold onto those memories.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]In the end, memories of Gado[XENO:n ]
are the only proof he was here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I'll never forget him, don't worry.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Thank you. For everything. I feel[XENO:n ]
like rebuilding the entire world![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]I know the feeling! But I'll be glad[XENO:n ]
if I can help out even a little bit.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Anyway, let's find the others.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
